particulars.title: Lunch and dinner, every day
particulars.text: Open for lunch from 12 to 4 PM and dinner from 6:30 to 11 PM, from a weekday business lunch to an unhurried family dinner on the weekend.

particulars.title: A quiet room in a busy block
particulars.text: A calm, green dining room on 9th Main Road in 4th Block, set up for conversations rather than noise.

particulars.title: For the occasions that matter
particulars.text: Date nights, birthdays and family gatherings, with tables for two and room for groups.

faqs.q: What are MOAI Jayanagar's opening hours?
faqs.a: Every day: lunch from 12 to 4 PM and dinner from 6:30 to 11 PM.
Yes. Everything on the menu is vegetarian, and every dish is cooked in cold-pressed oils.
